draft_key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased to MEUR 86.97 in Q1 2026, up 22.4% year‑on‑year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table and accompanying text (revenue row, Q1 2026 column).

draft_key_information_units.information: Net profit rose to MEUR 5.09 in Q1 2026, a 25.7% increase over Q1 2025, with a profit margin of 5.8%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Net profit row) and text 'In the first three months of 2026, the Group's net profit amounted to MEUR 5.1...'.

draft_key_information_units.information: EBITDA fell to MEUR 3.00 in Q1 2026, down 50.2% year‑on‑year; EBITDA margin declined to 3.5%. The figure excludes a preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 from the Marijampolės acquisition.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (EBITDA row) and text 'During Q1 2026 EBITDA reached MEUR 3.0 (a decrease of 50.2% ... excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5)'.

draft_key_information_units.information: On 16 January 2026 VILVI Group acquired 100% of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB, adding canned‑milk and butter production; the company will be integrated to capture synergies and expand whey‑processing capacity.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 1 – Main events during 3 months of 2026 (acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB on 16 Jan 2026) and subsequent integration description.

draft_key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production began at the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA factory in Bauska, Latvia, creating over 100 jobs, with planned output of 18 kt/year for export to more than 40 markets; the facility was awarded third place in the 2025 Latvian Construction Awards.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia' and the Latvian Construction Awards mention.

draft_key_information_units.information: Key operating‑segment developments: fresh‑milk products revenue grew 73.4% to MEUR 12.75, dry‑milk products rose 126.9% to MEUR 24.66, cheese‑segment revenue fell 28.8% to MEUR 37.64, and a new canned‑milk segment contributed MEUR 11.92 (14% of total revenue) following the January acquisition.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales revenue by operating segments table (Q1 2024‑2026) and note on canned‑milk consolidation from 2026‑01‑01.

draft_key_information_units.information: Net financial debt increased to MEUR 83.43 at 31 March 2026, up 89.7% compared with Q1 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Net financial debt row).

draft_key_information_units.information: Purchased milk (basic indicators) reached 155,954 t in Q1 2026, up 54.2% year‑on‑year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main financial indicators table (Purchased basic indicators milk, in tons) row.

draft_key_information_units.information: VILVI discontinued the use of transparent plastic lids for its yogurts as part of a sustainability initiative.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Main events section: 'Atsisakome skaidrių plastikinių dangtelių VILVI We are discontinuing the use of transparent plastic lids for VILVI yogurts.'

evaluation.selection_rationale: The selected units capture the material aspects required for a concise financial‑report summary: headline revenue, profit and EBITDA performance (core financial indicators); the strategic acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB (major business development); the new cheese‑production facility launch (operational capacity expansion); key segment‑level revenue changes that explain the overall performance; the group’s liquidity position as reflected by net financial debt; the significant increase in milk procurement volume (a primary cost driver); and a material sustainability action (plastic‑lid discontinuation). These items satisfy the priority criteria of headline financial performance, major period‑over‑period changes, explicit performance drivers, segment developments, liquidity, and strategic operations. The reference summary only covered revenue, net profit, and the acquisition, hence reference_support is true only for those three units.
